title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Owner-Retained Salvage Settlement: Desk Systems Reference
content:
**Subject.** The kept-vehicle settlement is the net settlement a customer accepts under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage when they keep a total-loss vehicle as owner-retained salvage, where the deductible option allows owner-retained salvage (every option does); a vehicle surrendered to Cardinal is settled under the surrender rules instead.

A vehicle the customer keeps is valued at its actual cash value in every case: new car replacement pays for a new vehicle in exchange for the damaged one and so applies only to a vehicle surrendered to Cardinal.

## When the settlement is worked out

The kept-vehicle settlement is not worked out until the vehicle's Deductible Rewards balance carries a credit for every completed claim-free year.

Restated: so long as any completed claim-free year of the vehicle is without its credit on the Deductible Rewards balance, there is no kept-vehicle settlement figure.

## Business effect of the customer's choice

When the customer keeps the vehicle and accepts the kept-vehicle settlement, one accepted settlement is recorded on the claim with the vehicle staying with the customer (settlement option owner-retained salvage), the net settlement figure the customer accepts, no loss payee payoff, and the offer and the acceptance both dated today. The owner-retained paperwork is still to be received, so nothing is paid by the acceptance. The customer sees the settlement as accepted with the vehicle kept.

## The acceptance tool

**Tool:** `keep_total_loss_vehicle_b04c3b51`

**Who runs it.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, choosing in person to keep the total-loss vehicle as owner-retained salvage and accepting the kept-vehicle settlement.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_number` | The claim number of the total-loss claim, as the claims desk gives it to the customer before the call | Text identifier |
| `settlement_amount` | The net kept-vehicle settlement the customer accepts | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `settlement_id` (reference of the accepted settlement), `claim_number`, `settlement_option` (always `owner_retained_salvage`), `settlement_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `offer_status` (always `accepted`) and `accepted_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying `settlement_id` means the acceptance is recorded.

## Reference questions

- *Does the acceptance record a lender's payoff?* No; the kept-vehicle acceptance records no loss payee payoff.
- *Is anything paid at acceptance?* No; the owner-retained paperwork is still to be received.
